While the PRIDE metadata lists 'acetylated residue' and 'monohydroxylated residue' in identifiedPTMStrings, there is no evidence of targeted PTM enrichment (e.g., phospho or acetylome) in the methods; these appear to be variable modifications used during search.

scope: The top 14 high-abundance proteins in the serum samples were depleted by Multiple Affinity Removal Column Human 14 (MARS14) using an optimized protocol. Depleted serum samples are processed with a surfactant cocktail-aided extraction/precipitation/on-pellet digestion (SEPOD) protocol and then analyzed using a high-reproducibility trapping-nano-LC/ultra-high-resolution Orbitrap MS strategy.
